description: List the approved community (learner-authored) bundles under BUNDLES_ROOT as {bundles:[{bundle_ref, course_id, item_id}]}. With course_id, only <course_id>/community/; without, the legacy root-level community/ (course_id null) plus every course directory's. Each bundle_ref passes unchanged to start_lesson_session. course_id must match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$.
name: list_community_bundles
